comparisonPolicy.normalization: Frame route uses max(abs(reference conditioned frame)); interval route uses max(that, whole-source PCM peak), because whole-input filtering can carry roundoff into a quiet frame. Window/spectrum divide once; power divides twice; zero scale uses one.

referenceToolchain.host: macOS 27 arm64; upstream universal macOS binary

logPowerSpectrum.definition: Natural log relative to one normalized-amplitude-squared second-squared; additive 1e-300 except no additive term at Nyquist.

powerCepstrum.definition: Square signed cepstrum; linear power, not dB. q[k]=k/fs including q=0.

powerSpectrum.definition: 2 * (real^2 + imaginary^2), including both endpoints; no window gain correction.

signedCepstrum.definition: fs times the 1/N inverse real DFT of the even real log-power spectrum; first N/2+1 samples.

spectrumImaginary.definition: dt times the unnormalized negative-exponent DFT, imaginary component; endpoint imaginary values zero.

spectrumReal.definition: dt times the unnormalized negative-exponent DFT, real component; one-sided including DC/Nyquist.

windowed.definition: Whole-interval resample; fused raw one-zero pre-emphasis; observed frame mean removal; unnormalized Gaussian2; explicit transform padding.
